opis: In the forest from the reference picture, a close view of a tree trunk with a SMALL round hollow in it. The SQUIRREL has pushed only her HEAD into the little round hole; her whole body is stuck OUTSIDE: her plump body pressed against the bark, her hind paws kicking in the air, her big fluffy tail sticking up, her front paws pushing on the trunk. The hole is clearly much too small for her - her shoulders cannot go in. A few acorns and nuts fall around, a leaf flutters. Funny, not scary: a comic moment, the trunk and the hole big in the picture.
